## v0.1.11

- Support OIDC group allowlists and administrator groups using verified ID-token claims, including Pocket ID's `groups` claim.
- Add group claim name, allowed groups and administrator groups to Settings → Authentication.
- Fix authentication settings saves that were incorrectly rejected by Emby connection validation; Emby/source settings are preserved.
- Add an explicit option to disable SMTP TLS for trusted plain-SMTP relays. TLS remains enabled by default, and the UI warns that disabled TLS sends mail and credentials unencrypted.
